# Me Nutrition

> Me Nutrition (also written MeNutrition; App Store name: "Me Nutrition: Calorie Counter" — AI Food Photo Scan & Macros) is an AI calorie counter for iPhone (free download with a 3-day free trial; optional auto-renewing subscription). Whole meal, one snap: photograph the whole meal and the AI counts every dish separately — calories, protein, fat and carbs — with an "ate half" slider per dish. Also logs by voice, text or barcode, and tracks water, workouts, steps and a plan to your goal weight. Available in 21 languages.

## What it does
- Whole meal in one photo: every dish on the table is recognized and counted separately (name, weight, calories, macros); slide "ate half" for any dish.
- Calories by photo: snap your plate — calories, protein, fat and carbs of the portion.
- Voice, text and barcode logging: say what you ate or scan a package.
- Restaurant menus: every dish labeled with estimated calories before you order, with translation in 21 languages.
- Water, workouts and steps (via Apple Health and Apple Watch).
- Allergies and diets: vegan, keto, gluten-free, halal and more.
- Streaks, reminders and achievements.
- Goal-weight plan with a first step and a final goal.
- AI nutrition coach with tips to improve.
- Metric and US units (kg/lb, ml/fl oz).

## Platform & pricing
- iOS (iPhone). Free to download with a 3-day free trial; premium features via an auto-renewing subscription, cancel anytime in App Store settings.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6767123368
